description: Sample player holding every WAV file in a chosen folder, with one of them selected by knob or CV

params.text: Picks which file in the folder plays, from the first to the last
Attenuates the WAV selection CV, from nothing through to its full range
When on, the file repeats from its start as it reaches its end

inputs.text: A rising edge restarts the chosen file; with nothing patched here the file plays over and over on its own
Adds to the file selection after its attenuator, 0-10V spanning the whole folder
Shifts the playback speed by a volt per octave, so 1V plays the file twice as fast and -1V half as fast and backwards below that

outputs.text: The left channel of the file being played
The right channel of the file being played
Nothing in the module writes this output; it stays at 0V, despite the panel printing END

notes: the outputs stay silent until a folder is chosen with Select Directory Containing WAV Files in the right-click menu; the module holds no files of its own
menu: Trigger Mode — Trigger restarts the file on a rising edge at TRG, Gate plays it only while that input is above 5V
Select Directory Containing WAV Files — points the module at a folder; its WAV and MP3 files are loaded in name order
Interpolation — Off, or Linear (Better Quality), choosing how the samples between two stored samples are worked out
Auto-Increment on Completion — nothing in the module reads this setting in the installed build, so turning it on changes nothing

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
